subject: a hand-thrown stoneware bowl turned upside down, its unglazed foot ring facing the camera, dense smooth grey-buff clay body exposed where the matte speckled oatmeal glaze stops in a clean line above the foot
positive: Editorial still-life photograph, a hand-thrown stoneware bowl turned upside down, its unglazed foot ring facing the camera, dense smooth grey-buff clay body exposed where the matte speckled oatmeal glaze stops in a clean line above the foot. One single warm tungsten light source from the low left, about 3200K, casting one long soft shadow with gentle falloff across a deep espresso-brown matte ground, low-key exposure, most of the frame in soft shadow. Muted desaturated colour grade, matte surfaces, no gloss, no reflections. Shallow depth of field, 85mm macro lens, fine film grain, quiet luxury interior magazine photography. Empty frame, only the object. No people, no hands, no text.
